title: The Last Bridge
author: Tamsin Nakamura
blurb: Cyrus Sandoval, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
